summary: T17-T20 platform channels (v4), all wired into the registry and verified by npm run test:protocol (146 protocol cases, 484 total). T18 WeChat iLink: long-poll + cursor + context_token + media descriptors + a loginDriver scan port. T19 QQ Bot: token outbound with msg_seq idempotency and the WS gateway (HELLO/IDENTIFY/READY/heartbeat/RESUME/reconnect). T20 DingTalk: signed webhook outbound + Stream gateway (auth/ACK/ping/reconnect) with inbound images normalized to attachment descriptors; message editing is not supported by the protocol, so updateMessage is declared false (documented, not hidden). T17 now ships the Feishu registerApp scan login, closing the last pending capability gap (PENDING_CAPABILITY_GAPS is empty). SUPPORT-MATRIX.json regenerated: 29 channels, 2 scan channels, 0 pending, 0 missing.
